g.text: The full Version 2 grid: matched accumulated PSI and KS
MATHEMATICAL SIMULATIONS; retrospective comparator. Every original grid cell is shown, 40 streams per cell, same seeds and records. Endpoint is any
post-onset alert in the full fixed group-feature family, not exact target recovery. Both methods accumulate to 100 using the same whole-batch blocks
and standalone horizon budget. Color scale is identical. Source CSV supplies Wilson intervals; paired intervals for every cell are in
paired_cells.csv. This is not evidence of natural-world detection accuracy.
